text:
elin: Follow-up on RFC: alternative to fully separate billing_event + audit_event paths. proposal: keep one append-only event stream but add a small 'delta' envelope for realtime fast-path + a claim/commit finalization model. idea is to reduce duplicate writes while preserving an authoritative ledger. sketch: realtime writes a compact 'delta' with finalization_token; async auditor claims token and writes a commit record if needed. thoughts?
samir: sounds interesting. main win is fewer write destinations. risk is correctness during retries and fanout. how does dedupe work across retries?
elin: plan: delta contains a deterministic origin_fingerprint and a finalization_token computed as h(origin_fingerprint + request_seq). the commit record references the token. auditor does a conditional write: claim token -> compute final_units -> write commit. if claim fails because token already claimed, auditor reads commit and emits no-op.
jessica: UX question: will customers see provisional balances? we need to set expectations and SLAs.
elin: yes, realtime increments reflect deltas immediately and are marked provisional. the commit phase is authoritative and may emit positive/negative adjustments. UI shows a provisional indicator and a tooltip explaining commit window (default 12h). enterprise seats can set commit window lower.
kai: storage/indexing notes: single stream simplifies indexing but commit records will need efficient lookup by token and by tenant. propose primary keys: (tenant_id, commit_position) with an index on (tenant_id, origin_fingerprint). commit_position is monotonic per tenant and stored via lightweight CAS.
samir: CAS on commit_position again - noisy tenants risk contention. can we use per-tenant append-only partitions (ordered log) so only a single writer per-partition sequences commits?
elin: yes, use tenant-sharded write pipeline, append-only log per tenant in Kafka. auditors consume partition and claim tokens by offset; commit_position is just the Kafka offset. avoids DB CAS for sequencing.
jessica: what about late-arriving increments (stream reordering / chunked responses)? need compensating entries.
elin: compensations are first-class: commit records include 'delta' and an optional 'compensation_for' token list. reconciler computes net change. example commit record (pseudo):
commit: {
  tenant_id: t-55,
  commit_position: 12345,
  origin_fingerprint: f1,
  final_units: 240,
  provisional_units: 200,
  compensation_for: [tok-111],
  trace_id: tx-abc
}
samir: good. need strong idempotency, so commit must be guarded by token atomics. also suggest embedding a small provenance envelope with model_hint, prompt_hash, and caller_id to aid disputes.
kai: operational cost: a single stream reduces duplication but commit records will grow (provenance + compensation lists). retention strategy?
elin: retention: deltas (compact) kept hot for 7d to support quick UI rollbacks. full commit records retained 1y by default, archived to cold storage after 90d. we also emit compact monthly aggregates for invoicing.
jessica: invoices must consume committed totals only. product: ensure reports join only commit_position <= watermark.
elin: agreed. add a 'commit_watermark' propagated to reporting systems after reconciler checkpoint.
billing-bot: infra note: will provision tenant-partitioned Kafka topic 'billing-commit-v2' on Tue 02:00 UTC. infra ticket: https://git.redwood/infraproj/1456
samir: migration plan? existing clients write standalone billing_event. need compatibility layer that converts legacy events into deltas and backfills tokens.
elin: migration steps: 1) compatibility shim that writes delta+legacy copies to staging, 2) dry-run reconciler that simulates commits without touching accounting store, 3) enable commits for low-noise tenant slice, 4) ramp with metrics. rollbacks: shim can be disabled, reconciler in dry-run toggled.\kjess: (typo) jessica: add canary matrices: pick tiny, medium, and high-throughput tenants and monitor adjustment magnitude. set alert thresholds for >5% net negative adjustments for any cohort.
kai: monitoring: instrument token_claim_latency, commit_lag, compensation_rate, reconciliation_success_pct. create dashboards + pager rules for spikes.
samir: dispute workflow: if customer disputes, we should be able to replay commits by token and reconstruct net position at any timestamp. ensure commit records are immutable and carry source traces.
elin: agreed. commits are append-only and include a 'source_trace' array of spans. enterprise option: HSM-signed commit receipts for non-repudiation.
jessica: one more: downstream billing pipeline should never read provisional deltas. implement strict contract: only commit_position checkpoints feed invoicing and usage exports.
billing-bot: reminder: add unit tests for token claim idempotency and compensation generation. CI job created: https://git.redwood/ci/metric/987
elin: I'll draft the RFC follow-up with schemas (delta, commit), migration playbook, and a runbook for stuck tokens and compensations. tagging you all for review.
samir: +1.
kai: +1.
jessica: LGTM.
